title: Squaring Numbers Ending in 5
summary: Tens digit times its next number, then attach 25.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Numbers ending in 5 have a neat shortcut.
points: Numbers ending in 5 have a neat shortcut.

steps.title: The method: Tens times the next, then 25
sentences: Multiply it by the next number, 4, to get 12.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: For 65, 6 times 7 is 42, so 65 times 65 is 4225.
You can test it: 5 times 5 is 25, which fits the ending.
